title: Velocity Lab
description: Drive a blocky car and truck through a physics lab to learn speed, velocity, acceleration and deceleration. Draw live v-t graphs, stop on the line with v^2/(2a), slide on ice and pass the Physics Driving Test.
controls: Up / W (or hold the right GAS pedal) to speed up, Down / S (or hold the left BRAKE pedal) to slow down; G switches graphs, R retries, 1-3 answer quizzes
